svg.title: Aziz Marnissi: I put AI on silicon.

g.text: Open to a 4 to 6 month internship
Final-year electrical engineering student at ENIT.
I connect algorithms to silicon so AI inference runs
fast and lean, from FPGA kernels to microcontrollers.
